ideas.title: CADGen: private 3D-print CAD generator
ideas.description: Type instructions (and optionally add an image) -> printable part. Exports Bambu 3MF, Onshape STEP or STL. Parametric template library (box/enclosure, plate with holes, tube, L-bracket, phone stand, tray, nameplate, hook), optional local Ollama LLM -> validated JSON spec with deterministic rule-based fallback, editable spec + 3D preview, CLI, tests. Built as its own exe.
ideas.category: Desktop Tools > 3D & Maker
ideas.author: Amir

ideas.title: CADGen: Bambu 3MF <-> Onshape STEP/STL converter
ideas.description: Converter tab + CLI between Bambu-compatible 3MF and Onshape STEP/STL, both directions. (Opening/modifying an existing Bambu file was asked for, then dropped.)
ideas.category: Desktop Tools > 3D & Maker
ideas.author: Amir

ideas.title: CADGen: image + text used together
ideas.description: Text selects outline/relief/emboss/engrave, sizes and caption; image supplies silhouette (extruded outline with holes) or heightmap relief.
ideas.category: Desktop Tools > 3D & Maker
ideas.author: Amir

ideas.title: CADGen: native CAD features for relief / imported meshes
ideas.description: Known limitation: relief and imported-mesh conversions are mesh-based (faceted STEP / STL), so Onshape gets no native features. Also: multi-plate Bambu projects flatten to one centred object set; image tracing is thresholding; no vision model installed so images are never 'described'.
ideas.category: Desktop Tools > 3D & Maker
ideas.author: Amir

ideas.title: QRGen: offline QR generator
ideas.description: Fully offline QR generator: text/URL plus Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, phone, location, calendar payloads; live preview; ECC/version/border/colours; module styles (square/rounded/dots); optional centre logo; batch from CSV; CLI; scan-verification tests. Exports SVG, Bambu-compatible SVG (mm, single compound path), Bambu-compatible 1-bit PNG, and any image format.
ideas.category: Desktop Tools > 3D & Maker
ideas.author: Amir
